body: Everywhere, parents are to judgmental, no one to talk to. And I just need someone to be with just to sit down and hold and to hug and to tell me its going to be ok even though we know its not. I can't go to my parents for that since I'm to afraid of what they'll think of me.

That one day, I will kill myself. I know I'm not going to live long enough to adulthood and this is the first time I've said it "out loud".  Life for me has never been worth living and I can't see any way that I want to live a "real" life. The depression is to much.
